_source.Study Title: Low-dose Simulated Galactic Cosmic Radiation Exposure After Hindlimb Unloading Has Long-term Impact on Skeletal Muscle Metabolic Proteins
_source.Study Publication Title: Low-dose simulated galactic cosmic radiation exposure after hindlimb unloading has long-term impact on skeletal muscle metabolic proteins in female mice
_source.Study Publication Author List: Martone Matthew  Irving Brian A.  Spielmann Guillaume  Johannsen Neil M.  Robinson Matthew M.  Chancellor Jeffery C.  Allaway Heather C. M.
_source.Study Description: Spaceflight stressors, including microgravity-induced unloading and galactic cosmic radiation (GCR), acutely disrupt mitochondrial function and contribute to skeletal muscle atrophy. The long-term recovery of muscle mitochondria following combined unloading and radiation exposure remains poorly understood. We investigated protein abundance changes 9-months after recovery from combined unloading and radiation exposure.
